[SWS_DM_01311] Realization of modeOfOperation AddFile (0x01)
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04135
⌈
If a service RequestFileTransfer with modeOfOperation equal to AddFile (0x01) is re-
ceived, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall call
ara::diag::FileTrans-
ferService::RequestWriteFile
with WriteFileMode equal to kAdd.
⌋
